faqs.q: Why are rats a problem in Martinsburg's older neighborhoods?
faqs.a: Older brick blocks, shared walls, alleys, and rail-side commercial buildings give Norway rats food and travel routes house to house. Our crew pairs trapping with sealing foundation and utility entries — treating one house without sealing it usually means the rats return from next door.
